objectives.statement: Every install instruction works without a PyPI account
The work of S042-S044 is reviewed: decisions, open assumptions, and where time was lost on both sides

artifacts.note: install from GitHub (git or release wheel), no PyPI
session review with efficiency findings and vocabulary

evidence.method: uv pip install git+https://github.com/9x25dillon/VIbe_coder_9xk1ll and the v0.2.0 release wheel URL, each in a clean venv
evidence.result: 0.2.0 installed; vibecoder levels lists the campaign

evidence.method: grep README.md and the v0.2.0 release body

evidence.result: its one commit is marked '-': identical patch already on main as 7a5940c

misconceptions.believed: A branch listed by git branch --no-merged holds work waiting to be merged
misconceptions.revealed_by: git cherry marked its only commit '-', an identical patch already on main under another hash
misconceptions.corrected_to: The branch is stale; merging would only add a redundant merge commit
misconceptions.generalisable_lesson: 'Not merged' compares commit ids; git cherry compares the changes.

decisions.decision: Distribute the Python package from GitHub, not PyPI
alternatives: Create a PyPI account and upload
decisions.rationale: The user does not want the account; git and release-URL installs both work with pipx and need nothing else
